# HVdilep_Zp500_piD2_mumu_ctau10mm

**AIDA-Scout S3 (displaced soft dimuons)** -- generated by `make_signal_cards.py`.

Identical to `HVdilep_Zp500_piD2_mumu` except that every decaying dark meson is given a proper lifetime of **ctau = 10 mm**. The ctau = 0 reference point is `HVdilep_Zp500_piD2_mumu` itself, which doubles as control C2.

## Configuration

* As `HVdilep_Zp500_piD2_mumu`
* `4900111/4900221/4900113/4900223:tau0 = 10` mm
* `ParticleDecays:limitTau0 = off` -- **required**; the default CMS-style `tau0Max = 10 mm` would stop the dark mesons decaying at all and make the sample silently invisible
* Cross section: **5.585 pb** (unchanged by the lifetime)

## Why it evades (or does not evade) the Phase-2 L1 menu

| Seed | Threshold | Fires? |
|---|---|---|
| PuppiHT | 450 (constituents pT > 30) | no |
| SinglePuppiJet | 230 | no |
| QuadJet | 400,70,55,40,40 | no |
| DoubleTkMuon (BPH) | 2,2, abs(eta)<1.5, dR<1.4, OS, dz<1cm | **intended: no** -- but see the blocker below |
| DoubleTkMuon (central) | 4,4 | **intended: no** |
| DoubleTkElectron | 25,12 | N/A |
| DoubleTkIsoPhoton | 22,12 | no |
| DoublePuppiTau | 52,52 | no |
| PuppiETmiss | 200 | no |


## Blocker -- read before using this sample

Specification open item 2 asks whether the simulation chain propagates displaced
decay vertices through to the PUPPI candidates. The answer for this repo is
**partially, and not in the way this signal needs**:

* Delphes' `ParticlePropagator` does start each particle from its true
  production vertex and does compute D0/DZ, so the sample is **correct at truth
  level** and the displacement is really there.
* But the L1T reconstruction in `cards/delphes_card.dat` has **no displacement
  dependence at all**. `L1TChargedHadronTrackingEfficiency`,
  `L1TElectronTrackingEfficiency` and `L1TMuonTrackingEfficiency` are functions
  of `pt` and `eta` only -- there is no |d0| acceptance term anywhere in the
  card.
* The evasion mechanism for S3 is precisely that L1 tracking is prompt and loses
  displaced tracks. **This chain will not reproduce that**, so the sample will
  look approximately as triggerable as the ctau = 0 point rather than
  progressively less so.

Using this sample to claim "displacement defeats tkMuon" therefore requires
either an added d0-dependent efficiency term in the L1T tracking modules, or a
real CMSSW Phase-2 L1 emulation.

A second, smaller effect at long lifetime: Delphes drops particles produced
outside the tracker volume (R = 1.29 m, half-length 3.0 m). At ctau = 10 mm
with the boosts in this sample a fraction of the dark mesons decay beyond that
radius, and their muons are discarded entirely rather than being reconstructed
in the muon system.

## Caveats specific to this chain

* **No external Hidden Valley UFO is used.** The hard process is Pythia's own
  `HiddenValley:ffbar2Zv`, so the 4900xxx identity conventions of the hard
  process and of the shower are guaranteed to agree. This resolves open item 3
  of the specification: there is no UFO/module mismatch to check.
* **`nFlav = 2` leaves roughly half the dark shower invisible.** The
  off-diagonal dark mesons `4900211` / `4900213` carry a conserved dark flavour
  and have empty decay tables; they are marked stable explicitly. Measured on a
  50-event test at m_Zp = 500 / m_piD = 2: 5.4 decaying vs 5.2 stable dark
  mesons per event. This is identical between the ee and mumu samples, so the
  controlled comparison is unaffected.
* **The vectors are forced too.** With `probVector = 0.75` three quarters of the
  dark mesons are `rhov`. The specification fragment pins only `4900111`, which
  would have left most of the visible energy on the default flavour-democratic
  table and destroyed the ee/mumu contrast. `4900113` and `4900223` are
  therefore forced to the same channel. **This is an extension of the
  specification fragment, flagged here as requested.**
* **No MLM matching**, per specification section 4. The hard process is the
  resonance only; the shower supplies all extra radiation.

## Running

```bash
apptainer exec --bind $simdir \
  /cvmfs/unpacked.cern.ch/registry.hub.docker.com/jmduarte/mapyde:latest \
  sh $simdir/run.sh HVdilep_Zp500_piD2_mumu_ctau10mm <nevents> <seed> $simdir False
```

This point uses the **pythia** branch of `run.sh`.
